title: •Prophetess
caption: •Prophetess (V)
game_text: Deploy -1 and forfeit +3 at a site. Once per turn, may peek at top card of opponent’s Reserve Deck or Used Pile; may then shuffle that Reserve Deck or Used Pile. Immune to attrition < 3.
lore: Renowned female psychic. Predictor of doom. Agent for Governor Aryon of Tatooine. Tailed Jabba and his thugs to Docking Bay 94 when they confronted Han Solo.
